contexts.statement: Bounded exploratory review of the 17 old Family-033 artifacts and one reference-input directory in PRIOR_DRAFTS.json. Assess all historical claims and versions without restarting the old search, altering old inputs, asserting novelty, or self-accepting the family.

definitions.nu: numerical dimension of a nef rational line, not Iitaka dimension
definitions.support: engineer assessment of a classical argument with explicit external inputs, not current independent acceptance
definitions.review_scope: all 13 historical claim IDs and 23 versions, grouped into six assessment units

claims.natural_statement: The current bounded review accounts for all 17 listed old artifacts and the reference-input directory, every one of 13 historical claim IDs and 23 versions, and all six mathematical assessment units, without counting duplicate arguments as separate results.

Under exactly the full marked-data, connected-generic-fiber pullback, compatible algebraic-line and prescribed resolved unipotent extension hypotheses in research/draft_reviews/weighted-two-tail/report.md, the historical classical argument supports nefness of every Lj and nu(sum cj Lj+tH)=nu(sum cj Lj)=nu(L0+L1) for every rational c0,c1>0, cj>=0 for j>=2 and t>=0, conditional on its explicitly listed external classical inputs. This is a review finding, not a new theorem, Lean certificate, Iitaka equality, verified novelty claim, or current independent acceptance.

The exact sl4 example x=e13, s=e24 has vanishing diagonal test but [[x,e32],s]=e14 and rank(ad(x*)|E)=3. It fails the universal commutator hypothesis, so the historical diagonal-only route cannot refute the actual root-kernel lemma.

The old tail argument and its exact local certificate do not establish the downstream reverse-logarithmic theorem, section construction, or all six grouped geometric interfaces. The current report names the missing premises, while separately supporting the conditional point-quotient assembly and numerical twist implication.
